prompts.original:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image: reference user's Lumo dark balance card. Primary request: produce a clean transparent cutout of ONLY the exact hollow lime ring character seen on the right of this card, at high resolution, faithfully reproducing it. This is a production hero asset, not a reinterpretation.
Character: a thick standing oval torus, glossy-soft acid lime 3D material. Its broad front-left surface slopes diagonally upward toward the right, with two elongated black oval eyes printed directly onto that LIME surface. The centre of the ring is completely OPEN, a tall crescent-shaped transparent hole visible on the right, the same as the reference. The rear-right curved rim is visible with darker green inner edge. Match the tilt, asymmetrical oval shape, thick front plane, gentle bevels and lit top rim. The shape is grounded on a flattened bottom contact. Keep the two little lime attention strokes on its upper left.
Composition: same three-quarter camera angle and pose as reference. Entire ring and strokes only, tightly centred with a small transparent margin. No card, no text, no numbers, no buttons, no border, no extra props. No WHITE FACE, no white disc, no pupils, no eyebrows, no mouth, no arms, no hands, no legs. Do not create a donut viewed straight-on. Do not create a letter L. The background AND the ring opening must have genuine alpha transparency. Omit floor, glow, and shadow; those will be implemented separately. Preserve the lime hues and soft studio highlights of the reference.
prompts.cleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image 1, the extracted hollow lime ring mascot. Keep the ring's exact silhouette, pose, eyes, three-quarter angle, lime material, top highlights, and two attention strokes unchanged. Remove ALL the diffuse green glow/halo outside the mascot. Make every pixel outside the solid ring and attention strokes genuinely alpha-transparent. The centre hole must be genuinely transparent. There should be no haze, ambient aura, floor, backdrop or shadow of any kind. Keep only crisp antialiased ring edges and the two solid lime strokes. Do not add a white face or disc, hands, legs or text. Crop with modest transparent margins so the ring fills the canvas vertically. This is a faithful production cutout, not a new mascot.

technicalPreparation: Alpha preserved. Crop (277,24,1267,1014) to a square around the solid generated ring and attention strokes, resize to640×640, WebP quality94. No painted or redrawn UI.
